messages:
emily: FYI — support ticket #75432 from Acme: their audit-log export completed but is missing ~72 hours of entries after a KMS rotation last night. export file link: https://s3.redwood/acme/exports/75432.csv
raj: noted. any alerts for export failures or KMS errors during that 01:00-04:00 UTC window?
mike: checking worker logs now. I see a KMS rotate at 2026-09-12T00:45Z and a few decrypt errors. sample log: 
```
ERROR ExportJob(75432): decrypt failed: key version mismatch: expected v3 got v2 (KMS-ERR-400)
retrying in 30s
```
seems like some workers used cached key material.
emily: customer says UI shows job "completed" and rows_exported = 1,234,567. they report missing rows for 03/01 01:00-04:00.
raj: can you grab the export run_id and the worker run logs? need run stdout/stderr and per-partition outcomes.
emily: support pasted this: 
```
run_id: export-20260912-0321
command: /bin/export --from=2026-09-01T00:00Z --to=2026-09-15T00:00Z --format=csv
status: completed
rows_exported: 1,234,567
attachments: export-75432.csv
```
no stderr in UI.
mike: pulled worker logs for that run_id. export iterates partitions; decrypt failures cause handler to skip partition but job keeps running. example: 
```
part 42: decrypt ok
part 43: decrypt failed (kv mismatch) -> skip partition
part 44: decrypt ok
```
so product code treats job as success if >0 rows.
emily: so data still exists as ciphertext in storage? not deleted?
mike: storage contains ciphertext blobs. DB marks partitions as exported (we'll need to verify flags). likely recoverable by re-running export with the correct key version.
raj: how many customers/jobs hit this during rotation window? running a quick query on export-job-metrics.
platform-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-09-12-KMSROT created by mike. Severity: P2. Assigned: raj.
raj: quick count: 6 export jobs across 3 customers showed decrypt-related skips between 2026-09-12T00:30Z and 2026-09-12T04:15Z. another ticket: #75490.
emily: customer asks: scope of missing rows (which users/orgs/events), is this permanent loss or incidental to export only, and do we need to notify other customers?
legal-team: high level: per contract and SOC commitments, we must notify affected customers of potential availability/integrity issues within 72 hours. if there's any risk of permanent loss, escalate immediately. avoid definitive loss language until recovery attempt completes.
raj: proposed plan: (1) enumerate affected run_ids and customers (done), (2) attempt replays using worker set pinned to pre-rotation key version to recover skipped partitions, (3) if replays succeed, notify customers with remediation details; if not, escalate.
mike: I'll coordinate replays. we can mount older key versions via KMS API (version history available). estimate ~2h to attempt for all 6 jobs.
emily: do we notify all customers proactively now or wait for replay results?
legal-team: send a holding message within 72h to affected customers saying we are investigating an integrity issue related to a KMS rotation and exports. we'll provide a follow-up once we confirm recovery. legal wants templated copy ready.
raj: starting replay for Acme export-20260912-0321 on workers pinned to key v2. progress: part 43 was skipped earlier — decrypt now OK, emitting 12,342 rows. continuing.
emily: I've messaged Acme support contact: "We've opened an internal investigation into your export; ETA ~2-4 hours for a recovery attempt. Will follow up with recovered results."
platform-oncall-bot: Replay job replay-20260912-01 for export-20260912-0321 completed. status: success. recovered rows: 12,342.
mike: replay successful for Acme. scheduling remaining replays.
raj: status: 3/6 replays complete, recovered ~29k rows total. 3 replays in-flight.
emily: drafting customer communication: will include timeline, cause, recovery steps, and next actions.
legal-team: please include a statement that we are not aware of data exfiltration and that storage integrity is intact; also include contact for escalation (legal@redwood).
mike: note for ops: export job should be updated to surface per-partition failures in UI and not return a blanket "completed" if any partition skipped. file a follow-up ticket.
raj: agree — filed ENG-TICKET-9876: "export: surface decrypt/skip counts; fail job on missing partitions by default; opt-in tolerant mode".
emily: after all replays finish, we'll send a consolidated update to affected customers and copy legal/security. if any replay fails to recover data, escalate immediately.
platform-oncall-bot: All replays completed. final tally: recovered rows across customers: 45,678. 0 jobs reported unrecoverable at this time.
raj: wrap-up: root cause = timing gap during KMS key rotation + worker key-cache not invalidated quickly enough. mitigation: change rotation to send a pinned key-version header to workers during transition and invalidate caches; ops will also add retries that fetch historical key versions automatically.
legal-team: prepare notification template. we'll review language for compliance.
emily: copying notes to support ticket and closing internal thread once templates sent. thanks all."
